courses.note: The Columbia CS core requires no algorithms course by name (CSOR W4231 is one of several area-foundation choices), so the required systems course is used. Newest public syllabus is Summer 2021 (pre-ChatGPT); probes for 2022-2026 instructor pages found nothing. The Fall 2026 section's materials are on Vergil.

Software engineering (COMS W4156) is only one of about 20 area-foundation choices (students pick four), and there is no required capstone; an undergraduate thesis is optional. Neither rule yields a required course.
